Optional lens corrections not implemented and disclosed. NoiseProfile advisory; no denoising claim.

rawDevelopmentPolicy: ColorMatrix(D65), AsShotNeutral, black/white levels, crop/orientation; finite SRATIONAL BaselineExposure applied exactly once in linear RGB. ProfileToneCurve validated and explicitly not applied before film look; optional lens correction warning retained. Mandatory unsupported opcodes still rejected.
memoryModelDng: No entire sensor/RGB plane: bounded rows with 8-row PPG halo, RawDevelop on each strip; stripRows<=128 chosen before sample allocation; conservative 32MiB + 96*activeWidth*(stripRows+16). Two worker threads. Entire original is never mmap-populated. Compressed blocks add actual max encoded bytes + bounded decoded block bytes + 4MiB decoder overhead; max 8MiB encoded and 4M scalar samples per block.
memoryModelCameraRaw: 128 MiB maximum; bounded allocation-free dummy sensor metadata, lazy input mmap; actual full integer sensor is admitted. Decode peak = 32 MiB + inputBytes + 2*sensorPixels + format-specific scratch (CR2 another 2*sensorPixels; NEF actual EOF padded block; Sony borrowed input). Develop peak = 32 MiB + 2*sensorPixels + 96*activeWidth*(stripRows+16); use max of stages. No full float/RGB plane, no automatic resizing.
metadataAdmissionCamera: Android wrapper inspects only classic TIFF root entries to choose resource reservation, not support. Non-DNG candidate metadata reserves 32 MiB through shared NativeWorkReservations (+16 MiB existing margin, max two active jobs). DNGVersion retains legacy no-heavy metadata restore. RawLoader profile database remains resident after lease release; fresh OS snapshots reflect it.
